svg.title: Runtime components of the Patient Journey Matcher
svg.desc: UML component diagram: the subsystem Patient Journey Matcher contains the crawler, the transcription job, the indexer, PostgreSQL and the MCP server. The indexer holds one indexer per approach (keyword, graph, ai_summary) and the MCP server one matcher per approach. The crawler requires the search APIs of the data sources, the transcription job their audio files, the indexer their file downloads and the annotations of PubTator3, both ai_summary parts the model API of an AI model service. Crawler, transcription job, indexer and MCP server use PostgreSQL; the MCP server provides the MCP tools that an MCP client requires.
